description: Source code implementing the c10::Error class and related utility functions for exception handling and warnings in PyTorch's C++ backend.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error/exception with message, backtrace, and context management.

classes.name: Warning
classes.description: Represents a warning with type, source location, message, and verbosity.

methods.name: Error::refresh_what
methods.description: Invalidates cached error message to be recomputed on next access.

methods.name: Error::add_context
methods.description: Adds additional context message to the error.

methods.name: Error::what
methods.description: Returns the error message string, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: Warning::Warning
